description: Deterministic VA development regression fixtures. These are authored test scenarios, not claims of independently validated NPU behavior or a held-out production benchmark.

documents.raw:
# ACLGraph replay divergence

## Conditions
- soc: Ascend910B4
- execution_mode: graph

## Observation
ACLGraph output differs from eager after the input layout changes. Cause remains unknown.

# HCCL rank map mismatch

HCCL_E_PARA was recorded while rank mapping differed between workers. Validate the observed rank and communicator configuration. It does not prove every timeout has this cause.

# NIXL prefill decode registration

NIXL KV transfer registration failed in the observed prefill/decode deployment. Remote memory registration and connector setup remain candidate causes; no successful device run is claimed.

# Triton UB pressure

An Ascend Triton candidate shows increased UB live state with a larger tile. Verify correctness across the shape matrix before comparing latency. UB spill is a hypothesis until profiler evidence supports it.

# Kimi K3 KDA compatibility

The Kimi K3 KDA path depends on the inspected vllm and vllm-ascend revisions. A graph capture success alone does not establish token correctness or compatibility with every release.

# ACLNN dtype mismatch

aclnnFoo_42 rejects the tested dtype and stride combination. The single operator case records float16 input and a noncontiguous layout; bfloat16 support remains unexamined.

# HBM allocation attribution

Serving HBM usage includes weights, KV cache, activation buffers, HCCL and runtime allocation. A fleet usage number cannot independently attribute these components.

# Ascend910B4 declared peak

| Quantity | Value | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| fp16_dense_matmul_peak | 245.76 TFLOPS | theoretical declaration |

This is a historical toolkit declaration, not measured throughput.

# Ascend910B4 measured matmul

A historical matmul observation recorded a sustained fraction of theoretical peak. Its shape, precision and software stack constrain the result. It cannot replace the theoretical denominator used by MFU.

# Eager operator failure

This operator fails in eager execution too. Investigate the minimal dtype and layout case before attributing the failure to ACLGraph replay.
